original_prompt: Nisa ile Eren, kütüphanedeki okuma etkinliği öncesinde Nisa’nın kırmızı ayracını bulamaz. Atlası en son kullanan arkadaşları Cem’den şüphelenirler. Yerleşik ipuçlarını araştırıp gerçekte ne olduğunu bulmalı, yanlış şüphelerini düzeltmeli ve Cem’den özür dilemelidirler.

requirements.meaning: Begin with the missing bookmark before the reading activity

requirements.source_text: Yerleşik ipuçlarını araştırıp gerçekte ne olduğunu bulmalı
requirements.meaning: Nisa and Eren investigate established physical/written evidence, discover the bookmark and explain its actual placement

requirements.source_text: yanlış şüphelerini düzeltmeli ve Cem’den özür dilemelidirler
requirements.meaning: Both friends correct their unfounded suspicion using discovered evidence and apologize to Cem

assumptions: Three classmates are 12; Turkish narration and six scenes are experiment defaults.
The bookmark was placed inside the blue atlas by Nisa yesterday; she does not initially remember or know its current location.
Nisa recorded that placement in her preparation notebook yesterday; no character initially knows the exact entry.
Cem returned the atlas without noticing the bookmark. He knows he returned the atlas, not where the bookmark is.
The written preparation entry and return log are authored established evidence, not inventions to rescue a scene.
Initial world/object truth is not automatically character knowledge; discovery must be earned in scenes.
All action can occur in the single established reading room; no travel is required.
